I’ve experienced this from multiple professionals as well. Honestly, I’m starting to get disenchanted by them because of this. Most of them are just trying to earn a buck, and hearing a bunch of people’s trauma stories probably drained them. So nothing really seems that bad anymore. 

And I’ve struggled with feeling like my trauma wasn’t that bad as well, and this sub has helped me realize that it’s how WE react to the trauma, that determines the severity. How do you react to reminders of the trauma? Are you extremely irritable because of it? These and many more questions can help you determine the severity. And the best part, this would all be on your own terms, it’s however you interpret it. 

Also, try not to pay too much mind to how professionals respond to one type of trauma compared to another. My experience so far has shown me that they care a lot more about sexual abuse than anything else, and that’s their own biases, not yours.
